scripts.db:schema: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute schedule-snap-db --local --file=../schema.sql
scripts.db:schema:remote: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute schedule-snap-db --remote --file=../schema.sql
scripts.db:tables: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute schedule-snap-db --local --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"
